en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a large castle or fortified residence situated atop a wooded hill. Below the castle, closer to the waterfront, are smaller houses partially obscured by leafless or softly blooming trees. There are several figures standing along the riverbank, with a stone retaining wall visible at the water's edge. The image exudes an old European atmosphere typical of pre-war or early 20th-century rural or small-town settings. No visible text is present in the image.
